statusText: Tail risk is low and below the block threshold. Stress stays elevated on generational long-end yields and Brent above $100, while the completed intraday retracement and a strong 10-year auction argue against a pathological path. Mapped policy state: EA_ON.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with a narrow caution window spanning the 18:00Z FOMC minutes through the 20:00Z cash close. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active per the standing contract.
headline: Nasdaq-100 retraces its gap-down after a strong 10-year auction cools a 24-year yield high
body: NDX trades at 31,130.15, down 94.53 points or 0.30%, against a 31,224.69 previous close, a 30,976.25 open and a 30,904.46-31,140.82 session range. The index gapped lower, set its low early and has since retraced about 226 points to within 11 points of the session high, so the day's meaningful retracement has completed rather than failed. December NQ futures trade at 31,363.50, down 0.38%, inside a 31,144.50-31,521.00 range. The dominant macro driver is the global bond selloff: the 10-year reached 5.32% intraday, its highest since 2002, with the 30-year near 5.68%. That amplifier relieved during the 17:00Z hour when the $39bn 10-year reopening stopped at 5.300%, 1.7bp through the when-issued yield, on a 2.77 bid-to-cover and 80.3% indirect participation against a 71.5% average; the 10-year has since eased to 5.28%, marginally lower on the day. VIX at 15.25 sits at the bottom of a 15.21-16.01 range, consistent with decaying rather than expanding volatility. Brent at $101.49 and WTI at $90.14 reflect Houthi attacks on Saudi airports including Jazan, which hosts a 400kbpd Aramco refinery, although the energy minister reports East-West pipeline flows recovered to 5.8 million barrels per day. September FOMC minutes are due at 18:00Z and cover the unanimous 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%; markets price roughly 17-22% odds of a further hike on October 27-28 and about 67% by December. Equity concentration remains notable, with Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft near a fifth of S&P 500 value after Tuesday's record closes. Taken together, event importance and elevated volatility raise Stress rather than Tail: no persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback sequence or failed-retracement pattern is observed at publication.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours began with a low-Tail trend-up regime into Tuesday's record closes, eased through the overnight globex and Asian sessions with Tail between 10 and 13, then deteriorated from 11:00Z as the global bond selloff pushed the long end to multidecade highs, lifting Tail to a 23 peak at 14:00Z in a trend-down mode. The last two hours improved to 20 and then 18 as the mode turned mixed and the gap-down began to retrace.
outlookSummary: The near-term window centres on the 18:00Z September FOMC minutes and the 19:00-20:00Z power hour, where conditional Tail peaks at 24 on the delayed post-FOMC second-leg mechanism. Conditional risk then decays through the globex and Asian sessions to 12-13, firms modestly from the 06:00Z European open on long-end gap risk, and rises again for Thursday's 12:30Z jobless claims and the 13:30Z US cash open, where opening-auction continuation is the main conditional concern. All post-17:00Z structure is conditional; only the current hour reflects observed price action.
